g.text: The delay costs nothing in gain and a great deal in phase, and the loss grows in proportion to

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: frequency: about 5 degrees at 1 kHz and 54 degrees at a tenth of the switching frequency. It is the

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: reason a digital loop cannot simply be designed as though it were an analogue one.
